prompt: Cinematic still, 9:16 vertical, medium wide shot, static, camera facing the sofa straight-on. A bright, airy neutral-warm living room, ceiling light on, soft diffuse daylight through sheer curtains, no dim moody lamp. A two-seat fabric sofa fills the frame; a realistic East Asian Chinese woman about 30 to 35 years old (identity from the reference woman), shoulder-length loose dark brown hair, wearing an oatmeal-beige knit top, sits at the LEFT end hugging a throw cushion, chin slightly raised, looking away and not at the man, sulking in silence. A realistic East Asian Chinese man about 30 to 35 years old (identity from the reference man), short neat dark hair, plain light-grey crew-neck top, sits at the RIGHT end, one hand resting on his knee, also not turning toward her. A clear empty gap of sofa between them, awkward silence, the very start of a quarrel. Matte skin with realistic pores, fine film grain, shot on an iPhone with true-to-life handheld realism, no oily facial glare, no highlight on faces, no plastic AI sheen, no wax. They are Chinese with East Asian faces, not western faces. Bright natural neutral-warm color, shallow depth of field. No text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark, no brand anywhere.
prompt_zh: 电影感静帧，9:16竖屏，中景偏宽，静态，镜头正对沙发。明亮通透的中性偏暖客厅，顶灯开、纱帘漫射日光，无暗黄压抑灯。双人布艺沙发充满画面；真实东亚中国女性(30-35岁，参考女主身份)，中长深棕披肩发、燕麦米色针织上衣，坐在左侧一头抱着靠垫、下巴微抬、目光看向别处不看男主、沉默生闷气。真实东亚中国男性(30-35岁，参考男主身份)，短发、素净浅灰圆领上衣，坐在右侧一头，一手搭膝、也不转头看她。两人之间空出一段明显的沙发距离，尴尬沉默，吵架刚起点。哑光肤质有毛孔、自然颗粒，iPhone真实手持质感，无脸部油光/高光/塑料AI感/蜡感。中国东亚脸，非欧美脸。明亮中性偏暖自然色，浅景深。无文字/字幕/logo/水印/品牌。
